parent.label: candidate-d
parent.selection: D is the sole implementation parent. It is not a selected performance release. F does not contain E's ranked_rows.clear expression and must earn every gate directly against released v032. Do not combine cells, rounds or improvements from D, E or F.

e_disposition.decision: E's three strict collection-reduction conditions failed despite equal payloads and verified tuple release. Preserve E as unselected; no E profile/paired run is authorized. This result does not establish the cause of D's old latency regression.

saved_evidence.scope: Previously saved D cProfile diagnostics only; these fractions are not uninstrumented latency estimates or promised speedups.
saved_evidence.source_observation: Token supplemental-unit ranking builds set(terms(rendered_text, query=True)) to obtain only a query intersection count. The final lexical_coverage field also consumes only that intersection count. Long CJK runs currently materialize every bigram. Actual avoidable work and latency benefit remain unmeasured.

hypothesis: For these two overlap-only consumers, compute exactly len(query_set.intersection(terms(text, query=True))) while retaining only needed matches, avoiding unnecessary full lexical feature list/set construction. Keep all returned scores, coverage values, selected units and complete responses unchanged.
authority: Prospectively registered extension outside the initial candidate-materialization-only scope. Implementation is authorized only after this exact scope is remotely committed. All original correctness, resource and performance gates remain fixed.
allowed_change: Add one private exact query-overlap helper and use it only for the final recall lexical_coverage numerator and the supplemental source-unit overlap numerator in assemble_with_count. Retain existing denominators, query sets, unit enumeration, renderings, sort keys, tie order, token fit checks and output assembly.

The ordinary fast path may avoid constructing irrelevant lexical features, including full CJK bigram lists. It must preserve the complete original normalization and lexical recognition semantics; a raw substring search is not an equivalent substitute.

Keep src/memory_book/text.py byte-identical to D, including public terms, query_terms, index_text, STOP constants and all excerpt behavior. The private helper may consume the unchanged constants/functions; it must not change ingestion, indexed text or exported lexical outputs.

Keep overlap caching local to the existing assembly call. A cached query-specific result must include the exact effective query set in its key, or otherwise prohibit sharing across different query sets. Different pages can supply different excerpt_terms. No result computed for the first page's query set may be reused as the answer for a different set.

Retain the original full term-cache/evaluation path for unsupported or custom inputs/callables. If a transition between specialized and fallback handling can change the original text-only cache's observable behavior, restrict specialization for that whole call or preserve the original behavior explicitly; do not waive mixed-input cases.
semantic_contract: For every specialized input, the overlap integer equals len(Q.intersection(set(ordinary_terms(text, query=True)))); duplicate query terms remain neutral and callers retain their original denominator.

Preserve NFKC, camel-boundary insertion, casefold, whole-string NFKD and removal of Mn in their existing order. Do not normalize per character, reorder normalization, or replace Mn with a different category test.

Preserve ASCII and Unicode word/identifier boundaries, identifier separators, STOP filtering, Chinese whole-question removal, CJK single-character versus bigram behavior, ZH_STOP filtering and compatibility-ideograph handling.

Empty inputs/queries, accents and combining sequences, case expansions, mixed scripts, punctuation, surrogate-containing strings and unusual ordinary strings must agree with the original consumer. A certified ordinary path must not suppress an observable custom callable/field error or change fallback evaluation/cache behavior.
Preserve complete source text, spans, citations, candidate_count, score arithmetic, temporal/novelty/coverage/semantic selection, strict character/token budgets and all cache/MCP contracts.
forbidden: No change to SQL, SQLite settings or statement-cache capacity, schema, ranking weights, route limits, scopes, model, vectors, tokenizer, dependencies or source data.
No removal or weakening of any native Row, ordered-key, value-length, primitive ID/rank, metadata coverage or original mapping/exception fallback guard. No generic cursor certificate.
No new persistent or cross-recall cache, no cache keyed by query identity/dataset, and no runtime conditions based on measured configurations or outcomes.
Do not reopen rejected FTS body-feature caches, highlight-range, novelty or project-local BM25 changes. This helper does not alter the FTS-body novelty pass.
Do not modify old helpers, plans, registrations, reports or negative outcomes; do not import E's unselected lifetime change. No performance claim from saved profile fractions.

correctness_before_measurement.fixtures: Retain all 79 D checks and existing lexical, token, corruption, custom-counter and optional-path fixtures. Add artificial differential overlap fixtures against unchanged ordinary terms, including Latin/identifiers, CJK singletons/bigrams/STOP/question phrases, mixed scripts, normalization-boundary cases, empty inputs and changed excerpt_terms across repeated rendered text. Cover custom/fallback behavior and cache-key isolation. Preserve any failure and repair before measurements.
correctness_before_measurement.static_review: Confirm text.py and every unrelated runtime file remain byte-identical to D; only the two named consumer sites and the private helper/imports may change. Independently review normalization order, complete Unicode/token-boundary semantics, fallback exceptions and qset-sensitive cache behavior.
correctness_before_measurement.output_checks: All complete non-timing responses must equal released v032 on the frozen development sequence. No retrieval quality tradeoff or altered source/index contents is allowed.

development: After reviewed F implementation and functional checks, commit exact source/runtime identity and a separate F intent. Use the unchanged full 4732-call profile and 4096-call native paired helpers once in new F paths, comparing F directly with v032. Preserve every cell, raw payload, negative result and partial attempt. No adverse-cell-only tuning or rerun of executed attempts.
formal_and_compatibility: Original 14-cell/66248-call formal matrix, aggregate p95 >=10% improvement, public native character p95 >=10%, actual MCP character p95 >=5%, no pooled p50/p95 regression >5%, resource review threshold, historical lexical and complete Q2 gates remain unchanged. Bind F and this exact addendum with all prior registrations in the three evaluators before any formal or compatibility execution. No formal/real compatibility attempt has started and no release is authorized by this draft.
review: Root independently inspected the two actual consumer sites and unchanged text.py, recomputed the cited saved D profile totals/calls, and reviewed the D-only parent, query-set-sensitive cache/fallback contract, normalization order and unchanged release gates before any F implementation or measurement.
integration: A later combination with separately registered T1 requires an explicit final source freeze and applicable gates on that single complete runtime. Neither T1 prototype results nor D/E/F development results may be spliced into release claims about another source identity.
